This depressed valuation comes paired with severe fundamental deterioration, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth of -122% [E19] and a devastating 72% year-on-year drop in sales [E64]. Furthermore, the company generates a negative return on assets of -1.99%, which drastically underperforms the sector benchmark of 3.52% [E7], and operates at a negative price-to-earnings ratio of -9.33x against a positive sector benchmark of 18.84x [E5]. Compounding these operational struggles, earnings growth is actively decelerating [E65], while expectations have dangerously run ahead of actual delivery as price growth exceeds profit growth by 51% [E48]. Finally, shareholders receive no cash return on their investment, evidenced by a dividend yield of exactly 0.00% [E3]. Finally, the claim of runaway expectations where price growth exceeds profit growth by 51% [E48] actually highlights that the market has drastically over-penalized a fundamentally sound asset base.
